NFRD SECOND REVIEW — 1 finding (1 Blocker). HOLD exact candidate `cand-7Z135ADMWYNVRV6680FXRFY3ZT` / `337600b60d11fdce8d7ef3f400de0aa65e6c5239`.

PLAN RECONCILIATION

- UPHELD: case-specific vocabulary remains package-private; production construction is closed; the public-package `fromProduct` positive control is non-vacuous.
- UPHELD: provenance and minimized-bundle availability remain independent typed axes; the survey fields stay Observation plus ObservationNotInBundle.
- SILENTLY DOWNGRADED: `docs/design/nfrd-baseball-diagnostic-court.md:327-339` promises a content checksum over the complete verification result and says no checked artifact may remain an unauditable side condition. `intake.scala:1119-1145` does not bind the verified `Origin.Diagnostic(root, reason)` or the retained artifact references/labels into `contentChecksum`.

ERGONOMIC / CONSTRUCTION BOUNDARY

No NFRD constructor or command leaks into library-public vocabulary. The four external compile-time courts pass, including the ordinary-case-class positive control. This finding is not a request to expose new public types; it is an internal receipt-completeness repair.

[BLOCKER] Incomplete deterministic receipt identity — `embed-bench/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/bench/nfrd/intake.scala:743-750,1119-1145`

`receiptFor` hashes source content/metadata, fixed-artifact checksums, manifest digests, counts, split, and lineage, then `verify` constructs `Origin.Diagnostic("nfrd:h2pkv/baseball", "one-story external diagnostic; not calibration or validation")` separately after the receipt. The verified output exposes that origin and retains typed artifact receipts/relative references, but their identity does not enter the advertised aggregate content address.

Executable counterexample in an exact exported candidate: I changed only the diagnostic root literal from `nfrd:h2pkv/baseball` to `nfrd:wrong-source/baseball`. The exact added suites still passed 21/21. Because origin is not an input to `receiptFor`, the content checksum is unchanged even though the verified provenance root changed. The temporary mutation was restored byte-for-byte afterward.

Deleted guarantee: two scientifically different verified outputs can share the same alleged complete input receipt, contrary to deterministic IDs/receipts and the candidate's own complete-result claim.

Disciplined repair: construct the checked diagnostic origin before the receipt; give it a stable canonical representation and include diagnostic tag/root/reason in the address. Also bind the exact typed artifact-label/relative-reference set, or a non-disclosing aggregate digest of it, so moving an otherwise identical artifact to a different declared snapshot reference cannot alias the same receipt. Add origin-root/reason and artifact-reference mutation courts that require the aggregate receipt to change without rendering participant paths.

SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED

- `receiptFor` should have accepted the checked origin and a canonical artifact-reference digest; it currently cannot bind either.
- The aggregate-receipt suite should have varied provenance root/reason and declared relative references, not only artifact bytes/checksums.
- No stale sum-type matches, weakened error channels, casts, nulls, warning suppressions, or new public escape hatches were found in the six-path diff.

VERIFIED VS INFERRED

Verified: direct parent `5180fea`; exactly six policy paths; diff check clean; all six blobs equal the previously reviewed `99602baa`; exact archive focused suites 21/21; origin-root mutation also 21/21; temporary archive restored byte-identical. Candidate evidence separately records the full cross-platform gate and real aggregate NFRD run. Inferred from direct dataflow: retained relative artifact references are likewise omitted from `contentChecksum`; I did not need participant bytes or edit the shared checkout to establish the blocker.

Please fix forward in a successor candidate. I will review the narrow receipt-identity delta promptly; this exact candidate should not enter Batch 1.
